tasks.title: Decide and document Kinetic → Rules BVI outsourcing model
tasks.involved: Rules BVI management; Operations; CTO; Finance
tasks.why: The group structure must identify which regulated obligations remain with Kinetic even where execution is delegated to Rules.
actions: Map each outsourced function: custody, KYC orchestration, blockchain analytics, technology and operations.
For each function identify legal owner, service provider, data location and subcontractors.
Confirm which functions may be outsourced and which governance/accountability duties cannot.
Create a formal outsourcing RACI between Kinetic and Rules.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A counsel-reviewed operating model clearly allocates each Brazil obligation between Kinetic, Rules and third-party vendors.

tasks.title: Confirm Rules BVI eligibility as foreign virtual-asset custodian
tasks.involved: Rules BVI CCO; Custody lead; External BVI counsel
tasks.why: Foreign custody is permitted only subject to specific conditions. Rules' licence and supervisory status are foundational.
actions: Map Rules' BVI VASP permissions to the custody service provided to Kinetic.
Obtain current BVI licence, good-standing and supervisory evidence.
Check the arrangement against each foreign-custodian condition under Res. 520.
Identify any legal opinion or cross-border enforceability work needed.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Brazilian counsel confirms in writing that Rules can serve as foreign custodian subject to identified contractual/operational conditions.

tasks.title: Establish Brazilian legal representative and callable guarantee/assets for foreign custodian
tasks.involved: Rules BVI Board; Insurer/bank if used; Compliance
tasks.why: Res. 520 requires the foreign custodian to have a Brazilian legal representative and assets/rights in Brazil or contractually established financial guarantees capable of being called for relevant custody failures.
actions: Appoint or confirm Rules' legal representative in Brazil with adequate authority.
Select compliant asset/guarantee mechanism and sizing methodology.
Document trigger, call process, beneficiary and enforceability.
Obtain legal opinion on effectiveness in all relevant jurisdictions.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Legal representative and enforceable guarantee/assets mechanism are in place and evidenced.
tasks.risk: Potential structural blocker and likely lead-time item.

tasks.title: Rewrite Kinetic–Rules custody agreement for Brazil requirements
tasks.involved: Rules BVI Legal/Compliance; Custody; Risk; Security
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 custody contract and foreign-custody provisions
tasks.why: A generic intercompany services agreement will not cover the specific access, monitoring, custody and supervisory requirements.
actions: Map mandatory custody clauses to the current agreement.
Add Kinetic monitoring/access rights over position records and relevant information.
Add BCB supervisory access rights and cooperation obligations.
Address segregation, instructions, service levels, incidents, subcontracting, termination and cross-border effectiveness.
Align liability/guarantee provisions with CUS-02.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Executed agreement contains all required Brazil foreign-custody terms and is legally effective in relevant jurisdictions.

tasks.title: Prepare and maintain Portuguese foreign-custody policy
tasks.involved: Brazilian Legal; Rules BVI Custody; Risk
tasks.why: Where custody is contracted abroad, the contracting SPSAV must keep the custody policy in Portuguese available to BCB.
actions: Obtain Rules' current custody policy and operating procedures.
Map them to Brazilian custody requirements.
Prepare an accurate Portuguese controlled version or Brazil-specific policy.
Define review/update ownership and version control.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Current, approved Portuguese custody policy is available to BCB and accurately reflects actual custody controls.

tasks.title: Implement Brazilian customer asset segregation and wallet/position mapping
tasks.involved: Engineering; Compliance; Rules BVI; Fireblocks owner
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 520 patrimonial segregation and custody controls
tasks.why: Kinetic must be able to prove which assets belong to which customers even where omnibus or foreign infrastructure is used.
actions: Document customer asset ownership model and account/wallet structure.
Ensure customer assets are distinguishable from Kinetic/Rules proprietary assets in records and controls.
Map Fireblocks wallets/vaults and internal ledgers to Brazilian customer positions.
Implement daily reconciliation and exception handling.
Design evidence extraction for BCB requests.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Daily records reconcile Brazilian customer positions to custody holdings with documented segregation and resolved exceptions.

tasks.title: Foreign-custodian ongoing monitoring, stress/exit and incident governance
tasks.why: Kinetic remains responsible for assessing the custodian's policy and continuously monitoring performance.
actions: Define custody KPIs/KRIs, incidents and escalation thresholds.
Create periodic review process covering licensing, security, financial condition and control changes.
Document contingency/exit and asset-recovery processes.
Allocate Brazilian and foreign responsible administrators for contract questions.
Test incident escalation and information access.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Ongoing custodian oversight is documented, assigned and capable of producing evidence to BCB.
